title: ThreatHeatMap Actor
description: Schema for a single threat actor record as stored in data/fixtures/actors_demo.json (Phase 1) and as the target shape for the MITRE / DLS connectors in Phase 2-3.

id.description: URL-safe slug used in API routes (/api/actor/<id>). Lowercase letters, digits and underscores only.

mitre_id.description: MITRE ATT&CK Group ID when available (e.g. G0032). Null for actors that have no formal Group entry (most ransomware brands).

mitre_url.description: Canonical MITRE ATT&CK URL for the actor or, when no Group entry exists, the closest software entry (e.g. https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1063/).

name.description: Human-readable primary name of the actor.

aliases.description: Alternative names used across CTI vendors (Mandiant, Microsoft, CrowdStrike, etc.).

country.description: Attribution country or affiliation tag. Free-form string; null when unknown.

type.description: Operational category. Enum is intentionally narrow; documented mappings live in data/fixtures/RATIONALE.md.

description.description: Short narrative of the actor's mandate, tradecraft and operational tempo.

ttps.description: Top techniques attributed to the actor. ATT&CK technique IDs.

tactic.description: Primary ATT&CK tactic for this technique.

sector_targeting.description: Per-sector targeting profile. Sector keys MUST match canonical names in data/sectors.json. p_sect is a long-term baseline used by the runtime only when the actor has zero victims in the selected window. p_ttp is the sector-specific TTP relevance coefficient.

p_sect.description: Long-term P_sect baseline for this (actor, sector). Range [0, 1].

default_security_score.description: Per-actor default SecurityScore (0..100). Used when no per-client override and no UI override are set.

security_score_overrides_by_client.description: Per-client SecurityScore overrides. Keys are client IDs (matching the top-level fixture clients[]). Values are scores in [0, 100].

victims.description: Documented (or simulated, in Phase 1) victim records. Sector strings MUST match canonical names in data/sectors.json. Date is ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD).
